title: Repository Policy Controller bootstrap repair after Migration 1049

phases.objective: Repair the missing canonical Repository Policy Controller registration surface discovered after the ledgered one-time execution of Migration 1049, without retrying 1049 or applying any live GitHub repository policy.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A separately governed repair migration can materialize or refresh the complete Repository Policy Controller registration surface with final single-owner metadata using duplicate-safe UPSERTs, while Migration 1049 remains ledgered and is never retried.
steps: Use 20260805_github_repository_policy_controller.sql as the canonical bootstrap source for policy, admin tools, capability, binding and export row shapes.
Fold the collaborator-aware single-owner metadata from 1049_github_repository_policy_single_owner_mode.sql directly into the final UPSERT values.
Materialize all critical registration rows with INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE so missing rows and existing rows converge to the same canonical state.
Preserve the existing repository automation plan/run enum repair from the canonical bootstrap migration.
Register Migration 1050 independently and retain live_github_policy_apply=false, no provider calls, no protected-ref mutation, no force push and no secrets.
Require separate future readiness and Apply authorization for Migration 1050; this repository change does not execute SQL.
assertions: The repair migration contains exactly seven bounded statements.
Policy, admin tool, capability, binding and export registration surfaces are duplicate-safe UPSERTs rather than UPDATE-only materialization.
The final policy and capability metadata use auto_single_owner_or_independent and Single Owner Review Gate.
Both repository-policy admin tools expose single_owner_mode as a boolean input.
Migration 1049 remains unchanged as an overlay and is not retried by the repair.
No destructive SQL, live GitHub policy apply, provider action, protected-ref mutation, force push or secret handling is introduced.
